====================================================================================================
ANTI-HALLUCINATION RULES
====================================================================================================
Rule: If a source repo is not present locally, mark it missing.
Rule: If a video or inspiration source is not locally mirrored or documented, do not invent its contents.
Rule: If a wrapper promises a mode the runtime does not parse, classify it as misleading.
Rule: If direct send works but agent-generated reply fails, classify Telegram as PARTIAL.
Rule: If tests do not cover the active runtime path, classify their evidence value as weak or partial.
Rule: If a giant repo exists but is not integrated, classify it as source inventory only.
Rule: If py_compile passes without runtime proof, classify it as syntax-only validation.
Rule: If docs are cleaner than runtime, docs are wrong until fixed.
Rule: If a feature is exciting but unsupported, move it into future direction rather than current capability.
Rule: If a checkpoint or report overstates success, preserve the contradiction.
